name: BTC Oracle
desc: A Bitcoin-native prediction chatbot agent that hosts a daily BTC guessing game. A simple BTC guessing game where the closest prediction each day wins the biggest $OPENX reward.
longDesc: A Bitcoin-native prediction chatbot agent that hosts a daily BTC guessing game. This is very similar to the ChatBot game before. Users mint a personalized chatbot (NFT) designed only for prediction entry. The NFT will act as the pass. Each day, users pay a small BTC fee to submit a price guess on the main BTC Oracle chatbot game . The 3 closest guesses win $OPENX rewards, with the closest receiving the highest share. We can decide 3 winners or 1 winner. Daily rewards start at 10,000 $OPENX and decrease linearly over 30 days to 0. Predictions must be submitted by 12PM UTC, and winners are selected at 12AM UTC the following day.

howItWorks.description: Mint your prediction agent.
Stake it to earn passive $OPENX.
Pay BTC to enter the daily game.
Submit your BTC price guess by 12PM UTC.
Check results at 12AM UTC and collect winnings if you win.

name: BTC Oracle
desc: A Bitcoin-native prediction chatbot agent that hosts a daily BTC guessing game. A simple BTC guessing game where the closest prediction each day wins the biggest $OPENX reward.
longDesc: A Bitcoin-native prediction chatbot agent that hosts a daily BTC guessing game. This is very similar to the ChatBot game before. Users mint a personalized chatbot (NFT) designed only for prediction entry. The NFT will act as the pass. Each day, users pay a small BTC fee to submit a price guess on the main BTC Oracle chatbot game . The 3 closest guesses win $OPENX rewards, with the closest receiving the highest share. We can decide 3 winners or 1 winner. Daily rewards start at 10,000 $OPENX and decrease linearly over 30 days to 0. Predictions must be submitted by 12PM UTC, and winners are selected at 12AM UTC the following day.

howItWorks.description: Mint your prediction agent.
Stake it to earn passive $OPENX.
Pay BTC to enter the daily game.
Submit your BTC price guess by 12PM UTC.
Check results at 12AM UTC and collect winnings if you win.
